title: Freya and the Orchard
author: Petra Reyes
blurb: Mirabel Galloway, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
